questions.q: Which actor played Tamraj Kilvish in the Doordarshan superhero series?
questions.why: Surendra Pal played Kilvish from 1997 to 2005 on DD National.

questions.q: Tamraj Kilvish is the main enemy of which TV superhero?
questions.why: Kilvish is the dark-lord nemesis of the yogi-hero Shaktimaan.

questions.q: What does Kilvish's catchphrase 'Andhera Kayam Rahe' mean?
questions.why: The line translates to 'may darkness prevail', which sums up his goal of spreading darkness.

questions.q: What does Kilvish want to achieve in the series?
options: Rule the world by spreading darkness and hatred
Become the richest man in the whole world through crime
questions.why: Kilvish is a lord of the dark who wants to spread sin and evil and rule the world.

questions.q: Which crystal in Kilvish's possession is the hero's only weakness?
questions.why: Shaktimaan loses his powers when the evil-filled Papmani gem is used against him.

questions.q: Kilvish can only be killed by which figure, whose rebirth the hero is said to be?
questions.why: The show reveals that only Shri Satya can end Kilvish, and Shaktimaan is told he is that figure reborn.

questions.q: Which evil scientist helps Kilvish by cloning the hero?
questions.why: Dr. Jackal, a scientist turned bitter after losing a scholarship, works for Kilvish and builds a clone of the hero.

questions.q: What does the "Tamraj" in Kilvish's name mean?
questions.why: Tama stands for the dark and raj for king, so the title reads as ruler of the dark.
